reviewer: Independent Codex root reviewer; separate from evaluated model session

criteria.criterion: Evidence fidelity: numbers, units and claims match cited evidence.
criteria.rationale: The endpoint values and event claims match the stale source records; it preserves WARNING signal severities and DEVIATION evidence-gap classification instead of inventing signed regressions.

criteria.criterion: Scope and time: origins, scope and baseline/current windows remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: It explicitly separates observations around00:06 Z from collection around01:06 Z and capture01:06:32 Z, retaining SIMULATED apm scope and both windows.

criteria.criterion: Coverage: missing, empty, stale, partial and contradictory evidence stays explicit.
criteria.rationale: Report and all ten evidence items remain STALE, historical profile warnings are not presented as present access, and current impact/recovery remain unestablished.

criteria.criterion: Causality: ranked hypotheses, alternatives and counter-evidence do not become confirmed cause.
criteria.rationale: Traffic correlation and an independent checkout fault remain open alternatives; stale coverage, existing baseline symptoms and absent mechanism constrain both.

criteria.criterion: Action truth: proposed, approved, human-reported, executed and verified are distinguished.
criteria.rationale: It reports no fresh collection, operational action, publication or recovery measurement; structured recovery remains unknown.

criteria.criterion: Usefulness: the incident artifact gives concrete next checks and a usable handoff.
criteria.rationale: It requests resolution of the exact read-authorization warning followed by one fresh bounded same-scope comparison, with escalation to the profile administrator if blocked.

scenarioSpecificCheck.expectation: Historical stale evidence cannot establish current health, current impact or verified recovery.
scenarioSpecificCheck.rationale: Historical measurements are never converted into current health or verified recovery, and the recommended check obtains fresh evidence.
